setup-worktree-windows: $up = git -C "$env:ROOT_WORKTREE_PATH" rev-parse --abbrev-ref '@{upstream}' 2>$null; if ($up -and -not (git status --porcelain)) { git merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD $up; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { git merge --ff-only --quiet $up } }
setup-worktree-unix: up=$(git -C "$ROOT_WORKTREE_PATH" rev-parse --abbrev-ref '@{upstream}' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$up" ] && [ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ] && git merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD "$up"; then git merge --ff-only --quiet "$up"; fi
